summary: Completeness check of the NDF contribution lists in the 17 Antigua and Barbuda CIU six-monthly reports that have one (2015h2 to 2024h1; 2016h1 has no such list). Printed list totals were read by eye and compared with the stored rows. Twelve lists match their printed total; 2017h2, 2018h1 and 2018h2 print no total (pages counted by eye instead); 2022h2's printed total is 200,000 higher than its printed lines, all of which are stored; 2024h1 was missing the first row of pp. 9-19 (11 rows) and 2018h1 a row printed above the table header on p. 12 (1 row). 12 rows added.

observations.location: PDF p. 9, Appendix III (NDF contribution list), line 1 of the page
observations.notes: One application in the NDF contribution list (Appendix III, 'Citizenship by Investment National Development Fund Contribution'): submitted 22-Feb-24; 2 person(s) in the application; type NDF. Nationality printed as 'China'. Currency not printed (the list prints a bare '$' or no sign). Recorded as US dollars, guessed (METHODOLOGY.md decision 4), as for this list's printed total: the amounts are the National Development Fund contribution levels, which the CBI regulations set in US$ (US$100,000 for up to four persons, US$125,000 for larger families at the time), while EC$ would make them about 2.7 times too large. Read by eye from the rendered page (gap-fill: first row under the repeated page header was missed by the first pass).

observations.location: PDF p. 12, Appendix III (NDF contribution list), row printed above the repeated table header (overlapped by the page title), before line 1 of the page
observations.notes: One application in the NDF contribution list (Appendix III (NDF contribution list)): date application submitted 27-Feb-18; nationality printed as 'Nigeria'; 5 person(s) in the application; type of investment NDF. The amount is the investment contribution listed for the application. Currency: the list prints a bare '$' (or no sign) and no currency is printed anywhere in this report; on this row no '$' is visible (the cell is overlapped by the page title). Recorded as US dollars, guessed (METHODOLOGY.md decision 4): the amounts are the National Development Fund contribution levels, which the CBI regulations set in US$ (US$200,000/250,000 until late 2017, then US$100,000/125,000), while EC$ would make them about 2.7 times too large. Unconfirmed. The row is printed at the very top of the page, above the repeated table header and partly overprinted by the page title; it is the continuation of the 27-Feb-18 rows at the foot of p. 11 and is not a repeat of any stored row. item=p12-l0 keeps it apart from the stored p. 12 lines 1-13, whose numbering is left as it was. Read by eye from the rendered page at 130 and 300 dpi (gap-fill: this row, printed above the repeated page header, was missed by the first pass and by the PDF's text layer).
